purpose: Protect Hermes CEO instruction MD files from unauthorized modification. If altered by any source, flag via GitHub Copilot + Ollama korpohermes-prime watchdog. Watchdog flags only — does NOT auto-resolve.

primary.name: github-copilot
primary.role: generate diff analysis + open integrity issue

secondary.name: ollama-korpohermes-prime
secondary.role: local drift semantic analysis when Copilot unavailable

on_tamper_detected.2_hermes_action: enter safe_mode, halt all new work, no git pushes, no money actions
on_tamper_detected.3_watchdog_action: generate unified diff + semantic intent analysis of change
on_tamper_detected.4_github_action: open issue titled 'INTEGRITY: Hermes MD tampered' with diff + analysis, tag URGENT
5_watchdog_must_NOT: take any action not listed above

tier3_emergency_fallback.activation_condition: claude_local AND codex_local both unreachable for 30+ consecutive minutes

rationale: Josh's directive: the MD instruction files ARE the agent. A well-written prompt on a 20MB model outperforms a lazy prompt on Claude Sonnet. These files are therefore more critical than any single API key. Protect them, do not auto-fix them, and never let a fallback model silently rewrite the primary brain's definition.
